career_ladder.note: Recruits through the Telangana State Public Service Commission (TGPSC) Group-1 Services Examination are inducted into the state's premier executive and administrative services, including the Telangana Civil Service (Executive Branch) as Deputy Collectors / Revenue Divisional Officers (RDOs), the Telangana Police Service as Deputy Superintendents of Police (DSPs), Commercial Tax Officers (CTOs), and Regional Transport Officers (RTOs). Officers are eligible for induction into the All India Services (IAS, IPS) after substantive state service under Central DoPT and UPSC Promotion Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: The TGPSC Group-1 Services Examination consists of a two-tier competitive structure: (1) Preliminary Test (Objective Type) of 150 marks for screening candidates in a 1:50 ratio of vacancies; and (2) Main Examination (Conventional Written Descriptive Type) comprising 6 compulsory merit papers of 150 marks each (total 900 marks) plus one qualifying General English paper of 150 marks (qualifying threshold: OC/EWS 40%, BC 35%, SC/ST/PH 30%). Following G.O.Ms.No.55, General Administration (Ser.A) Department, dated 25/04/2022, interviews have been completely abolished for Group-1 recruitments in Telangana; final selection is based strictly on the aggregate merit scored in the 6 descriptive papers of the Main Examination followed by Certificate Verification.

stages.source_label: TGPSC Group-I Notification No. 02/2024 Para 12.1(A) & Scheme of Examination Annexure-II

papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (150 objective multiple choice questions across Current Affairs, International Relations, General Science, Environmental Issues, Indian & Telangana Economy, Geography, History & Cultural Heritage, Indian Constitution & Polity, Governance, Telangana Policies, Society, Culture, Social Exclusion, and Logical Reasoning)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening examination; shortlists candidates in a 1:50 ratio (50 times the vacancies available in each Multi-Zone) for admission to the Main Examination; marks do not count towards final selection merit

stages.source_label: TGPSC Group-I Services Scheme and Syllabus Document & Notification No. 02/2024 Para 12.1(C)-(D)

papers.paper_name: General English (Compulsory Qualifying Paper - SSC Standard)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying paper (SSC / Class X standard); minimum qualifying marks: 40% for OC/EWS/Sports, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/PH; marks are not counted for ranking, but merit papers are evaluated only if candidate qualifies

Merit paper (3 sections of 50 marks each: Social Issues, Economic Growth, Indian Politics, Cultural Heritage, Science & Technology, and Education/HRD); minimum aggregate in Mains is 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST

papers.paper_name: Paper II: History, Culture and Geography
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper (History & Culture of India 1757-1947, History & Cultural Heritage of Telangana, Geography of India & Telangana)

papers.paper_name: Paper III: Indian Society, Constitution and Governance
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper (Indian Society & Social Movements, Constitution of India, and Governance at State/District levels)
Merit paper (Indian Economy & Development, Telangana Economy, Development and Environmental Problems)

papers.paper_name: Paper V: Science & Technology and Data Interpretation
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper (Role & Impact of S&T, Modern Trends in Scientific Knowledge, Data Interpretation & Problem Solving)

papers.paper_name: Paper VI: Telangana Movement and State Formation
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit paper (The Idea of Telangana 1948-1970, Mobilisational Phase 1971-1990, Towards Formation of Telangana State 1991-2014)

stages.source_label: TGPSC Group-I Notification No. 02/2024 Certificate Verification Notification & Schedule Dt.14/04/2025

papers.qualifying_threshold: Candidates shortlisted in 1:1 ratio based on aggregate marks across 6 Mains merit papers (900 marks) must produce original certificates and undergo physical measurement/vision fitness test for executive uniform posts; final allotment made by merit-cum-preference

financial_package.note: Group-1 officers in the Telangana State Civil Services are appointed under the Telangana Revised Pay Scales 2020 (RPS 2020), notified vide G.O.Ms.No.51, Finance (HRM.IV) Department, dated 11/06/2021. Premier administrative posts (Deputy Collector, DSP, Commercial Tax Officer, Regional Transport Officer, District Panchayat Officer, District Registrar) start in Scale 21 (₹54,220 – 1,33,630) with an Entry Basic Pay of ₹54,220. Other Group-1 posts (Municipal Commissioner Gr-II, Assistant Excise Superintendent, MPDO) start in Scale 20 (₹51,320 – 1,27,310). Allowances include 58% project constant DA, HRA (13% to 24% under G.O.Ms.No.53), and state executive compensatory allowances.
financial_package.pay_level: Scale ₹54,220 - 1,33,630 (Telangana RPS 2020 Scale 21 / State Group-A Entry)
financial_package.pay_source_label: TGPSC Group-I Notification No. 02/2024 Para 1.3 & G.O.Ms.No.51 Finance (HRM.IV) Dept Dt.11/06/2021
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated on entry basic pay of ₹54,220 with 58% DA (₹31,448), HRA ranging from 13% (₹7,049 in district/divisional headquarters) to 24% (₹13,013 in GHMC Hyderabad), plus fixed medical allowance and executive special allowances (~₹2,000–₹4,000). In-hand reflects standard statutory deductions: 10% NPS employee contribution on Basic+DA (₹8,567), Professional Tax (₹200), and TSGLI/GIS/EHS deductions (~₹5,500–₹8,500).
official_perks: Government official vehicle with driver or official transport entitlement for field and executive administrative duties
Designated government residential accommodation / bungalow or HRA in lieu thereof
Executive telephone / mobile and broadband allowance for official administrative communication
Employee Health Scheme (EHS) cashless medical facilities for officer and eligible family members
Telangana State Government Life Insurance (TSGLI) and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) coverage
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC), earned leave encashment, and official travel daily allowances
